title: People’s Mañanera September 9
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**2027 Economic Package: Well-Being for the People  
** Without any new taxes or gas price hikes in the works, government well-
being programs and public investment are guaranteed. In 2027, 1.1 trillion
pesos (US$59.21 billion) will be earmarked for well-being programs. Under the
Fourth Transformation, 13.5 million people were lifted out of poverty.
President Claudia Sheinbaum explained that “there would be no point in
generating more wealth if inequalities remain the same.”

**Fobaproa: The Private Debt the People Continue to Pay  
** In 2027, a total of 48 billion pesos (US$2.84 billion) will go to the Bank
Savings Protection Institute (IPAB), a legacy of the Bank Savings Protection
Fund (Fobaproa). Although 1.6 trillion pesos (US$94 billion) have been paid,
the debt continues to be refinanced. Now, bank payments will no longer be tax-
deductible. The President announced that “we will present a fully detailed
report on how Fobaproa was created.”

**Pemex: Never Again Will It Be a Petty Cash Fund  
** Under former president Enrique Peña Nieto, Pemex’s debt grew by 129.5%;
under the 4T administration, it has been reduced by nearly US$20 billion.
Pemex is now being supported in paying off its debt, and the debt is no longer
charged to Pemex.

**Security: Less Violence, More Peace  
** Intentional homicides fell by 53%—46 fewer each day. Under Calderón,
homicides rose by 148%, a strategy that Sheinbaum described as “a state of
emergency without declaring it as such.” Today, the focus is on the root
causes, intelligence work, and coordination.

**Sovereignty: Representing Only Mexico  
** Anyone aspiring to become president or a state governor must represent
Mexico exclusively, without prejudice to those with dual citizenship. The
President stated that “they cannot swear allegiance to two flags because they
represent only one nation.” To govern is to defend Mexico.

**Lie Detector**

  * It is not true that President Claudia Sheinbaum was booed during an event in Colima.
  * It is not true that Mexico’s public finances are facing structural weakening or that the country is losing credibility and the trust of international markets and foreign investors.
  * It is not true that the Mexican government’s scholarships and stipends consist solely of giving away or “handing out money” without any requirements.
  * It is not true that the Olmeca Refinery in Dos Bocas is inoperative and “is not even functioning at 20%” of its capacity.
  * It is not true that President Sheinbaum proposed a bill to prohibit senior citizens from using cell phones and driving motor vehicles.
